Explain a diagnostic code or a language construct, offline.

Looks the topic up in the error catalog first (`largo explain zero-index` — every code from `check --json` and the MCP tools), then in the teach lessons (`largo explain Let`). No project or network needed.

Usage: largo explain [OPTIONS] <TOPIC>

Arguments:
  <TOPIC>
          An error code (kebab-case) or a construct name

Options:
      --json
          Print the entry as one `logos-explain/1` JSON document

  -q, --quiet
          Suppress informational output (errors still print)

  -v, --verbose...
          Increase output verbosity (repeatable)

      --color <WHEN>
          When to use terminal colors

          Possible values:
          - auto:   Color when stdout/stderr is a terminal and `NO_COLOR` is unset
          - always: Always emit ANSI, even into pipes (CI logs, `less -R`)
          - never:  Never emit ANSI
          
          [default: auto]

  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
  largo explain zero-index
  largo explain use-after-move
  largo explain Let
  largo explain zero-index --json
